title: Water safety
info: Swim only where an adult said it is safe. Rivers can have currents you cannot see.
Do not dive into water if you do not know how deep it is.
If someone is in trouble, call an adult. Do not jump in if you cannot rescue safely.

questions.q: Before you dive, you must know
If someone needs help in the water and you are not a trained rescuer
options: Jump in immediately even if you cannot swim
Call an adult and do not jump in
